## Checklist

- [ ] The project folder is `members/<discord-username>/<project-id>/`, and the names match the fields above.
- [ ] The project README lists the Discord username, project identifier, and kind.
- [ ] The member page lists this project. The member index links to that page when this is the member's first project.
- [ ] The project `LICENSE` is the license chosen by the member who shared it.
- [ ] No API keys, `.env` files, or other secrets are included. `SKYLIT_API_KEY` in `.env.example` is empty.
